rounds.text: SMR Jewels Ltd is trading at an exceptionally modest P/E ratio of 6.57 while sitting only 29% of the way up its 52-week range [E1, E4]. The company boasts extraordinary profitability metrics, highlighted by a 3-year compounded profit growth of 201% and trailing twelve-month profit growth of 138% [E9, E10]. Operational efficiency is equally formidable, evidenced by an ROCE of 71.9% and a 3-year median ROE of 72%, vastly outperforming the sector median ROCE of 9.9% [E5, E11, E42]. Top-line expansion matches this bottom-line momentum, driven by a 3-year compounded sales growth of 86% and a trailing twelve-month sales growth of 64% [E7, E8]. Furthermore, operating margins have expanded by 5 percentage points over three years to reach 8% in March 2026, supported by a multi-year increasing margin trend [E13, E14]. A reverse DCF indicates that the current market price absurdly prices in a -7.7% earnings decline against a baseline expectation of 18.0% growth, leaving a massive implied margin of safety [E29]. Conceded: operating cash flow was negative Rs 16 Cr in March 2026, resulting in a negative cash conversion of -0.64x [E16, E17].
